criteria.text: Adding an item sets its quantity and raises the subtotal; adding the same SKU twice merges into one line.
Coupon SAVE10 takes 10% off the subtotal; the shipping fee is not discounted.
A second coupon is rejected with CouponError and the first coupon stays applied.
Removing the last item empties the cart and clears any applied coupon.
A coupon worth more than the subtotal makes the item total zero, never negative; shipping is still charged.
Adding an out-of-stock item raises OutOfStock and leaves the cart unchanged.
